concept: Route 53: failover routing with health checks
tests: How to set up DNS failover of a static S3 website to a secondary bucket in another Region.
expected: Route 53 failover routing policy + health checks: if the primary fails, traffic goes to the secondary. Triggers: "automatic failover", "secondary in another Region", "using DNS".
why_not: Simple — no failover; weighted — splits traffic by weight; latency-based — optimizes latency but doesn't switch on health checks.
